GOD ALONE PERFECTLY JUDGES EVERY PERSON.

DIVISION 1 — ALL PEOPLE WILL FACE THE JUDGMENT OF A RIGHTEOUS GOD. – ROMANS 2:1-16

Principle

God judges every thought, word, and deed based on absolute truth.

Application Question

HOW MIGHT YOU BE SHOWING CONTEMPT FOR GOD BY JUDGING OTHERS?

DIVISION 2 —	 A CHANGED HEART, NOT RITUALS NOR ANCESTRY, IS THE MARK OF A TRUE BELIEVER. Romans 2:17-29

Principle

A BELIEVER'S RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD REQUIRES HEART TRANSFORMATION BY HIS SPIRIT.

Application Question

WHAT IS THE ATATE OF YOUR HEART TOWARDS GOD?
